mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, logistics_platform, main_id, name, account, password
mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.id AS authId, la.main_id, la.name, la.logistics_platform, ls.supplier_id, ls.supplier_name, ls.auth_status FROM logistics_auth la INNER JOIN logistics_supplier ls ON ls.id=la.main_id and ls.is_deleted=false WHERE ls.id=(SELECT main_id FROM logistics_channel WHERE id=#{channelId} and is_deleted=FALSE ) AND la.is_deleted=false

SELECT la.id, la.id AS authId, la.main_id, la.name, la.logistics_platform, ls.supplier_id, ls.supplier_name, ls.auth_status FROM logistics_auth la INNER JOIN logistics_supplier ls ON ls.id=la.main_id and ls.is_deleted=false WHERE ls.id=#{logisticsSupplierId} AND la.is_deleted=false

SELECT lc.id AS channelId FROM logistics_auth la INNER JOIN logistics_supplier ls ON ls.id = la.main_id AND ls.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN logistics_channel lc ON lc.main_id = ls.id AND lc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE la.is_deleted = FALSE AND la.logistics_platform IN
#{platform}
